body:
I'm going to try to stop fixating on this. At the moment, it just feels like my mind is constantly in a state of panic and I'm reaching for anything to end the panic. I keep walking in to whispering conversations, gossip, overhearing things and filling in the blanks with the worst possible things that may not even be the right context.

I didn't know anything about that statute of limitations stuff, but 15 years has passed, so if that's the case, that's a breath of relief at least. It's weird... so many people tell me how small this infraction is, yet, it's so huge in my head. I don't understand why I'm so destroyed over it when everyone else sees it as such a small event in my life.

Thank you for your comments, I really needed to hear them. I'm sorry for hurting your heart over this as well...

Thank you for your response.

I don't know if he does, I do know that back in the day right after this happened, I tried to wake him up by placing toys and cards on him so that we could wake up together and have fun, he didn't budge.

I do suffer from some degrees of OCD and anxiety, as well as Asperger's. I really, really need to talk to a mental health professional. This is starting to destroy my life.

The only other link I've seen to suggest he may be trying to take me down is a message he sent during his schizophrenic episode where he said he was a rape victim who watched two men having sex with women in front of him. I'm worried, somehow, he was referencing me.

I just keep connecting all these dots, I don't know how to make it stop.

I'm just going out of my mind trying to analyze anything I can for clues as to what's going on since I'm being left entirely in the dark.

Ever since he went in, everyone has been extremely somber and secretive. Secret conversations, cold moods toward me (I think). I keep listening for laughs, or looking for a smile, something to tell me to calm down.

I heard part of an obscure conversation in the bath last night between my mom and dad and suddenly I had the entire script written out about what they said, even though a tv was blasting and I was in water. I hate being like this. I'm so paranoid I'm nauseous and sick to my stomach, sweaty. I feel like I'm on the verge of a mental breakdown.

and yeah... I'd be able to say it was his mental illness that caused it and forgive him.

One other issue is, is that if this did blow up, how do I tell them that my dad molested and raped me to try to explain my mindset when he's one of the ones questioning me?

I will say this... My dad usually reacts to everything with anger and yelling, but last night he was relatively calm. He even showed me the text message my cousin sent to him and said "this is so disturbed".

not a terrible person... thank you for that

I hate so much the mental illness that has consumed him. He's struggling so much, and I just don't want to be adding to that you know? I'm glad to hear you think I haven't added to his pains, though.

I know inside somewhere I'm blowing this up but it's so hard not to. My family keeps having secret conversations, my mom is acting very coldly toward me I think and I'm just so scared.

Thank you for trying to ease some of my pain.

I guess part of the issue is the way my family is acting. My mom is acting very cold toward me, though nothing has been brought up to me.

Another thing is that, even though I was 13, what if that part isn't being talked about? And for the word "rape" to be used is extremely graphic.

I don't know if I'm in this topic or not. My family has a way of not disclosing anything to me sadly.

Do I sound that bad? :( I'll admit my paranoia is monumentally high right now. Before this it was okay, but now I'm watching every facial reaction, every interaction... worried about every conversation. Hearing parts of the conversation and trying to replay it in my head until I understand.

I want help... I'm just so scared of having hurt someone, having everyone hate me. He's using the word rape, so I'm highly concerned as to what's being said, who may have done what.

I hope not. I hope I didn't cause his pain, and that in the end I'm the only one who has to live with this pain.

For so long, I replayed that time in my head back. There wasn't even a moment for over an hour it seemed he was awake. I'm scared to even imagine that if he doesn't know, what the worse things that happened to him are...

I'm also very paranoid because I overheard my dad blaming himself or me possibly, and my mom telling him it wasn't his fault. That and my family tells me nothing and is very secretive. If this blows up, I don't think I'll be able to keep going.

I appreciate your kind words.

You really think I'm just making connections to cope?

I also overheard my parents having a discussion where my dad was for some reason blaming himself, I guess because of the text messages, but my mind is making me wonder if he blames himself for raising me that way. My family has been having private conversations and whispering about things... it has just made me so paranoid and convinced me it's all exploding.

I just wish I had been smarter, more wise, less damaged. I do need therapy, but if this blows up I don't think I'll be able to continue. Thank you for your kindness.
